text:
hana: Quick heads-up from today's veridian-v2 (q4) onboard run: noticed odd token merges affecting CJK inline annotations and a couple RTL punctuation reversals. overall en->ja BLEU on the srt slice dropped ~4.8.

rui: can you drop a minimal repro?

hana: pasted two tiny examples from the failing slice (baseline float vs q4-compact).

hana: JA inline-annotation:
SRC: \u300e\u4e0b\u66f8\u306e\u7d42\u4e86\u300f
REF: "End of volume."
BASE: tokens: [T1,T2,T3] -> "End of volume."
Q4: tokens: [T1,T3] -> "End of volume"  <-- missing middle token; sometimes sees stray U+FF3D appended.

hana: ZH ruby-like sample:
SRC: "\u6f22\u5b57\uE010( pinyin )"
REF: "kanji (pinyin)"
BASE: "kanji (pinyin)"
Q4: "kanji(pinyin"  <-- missing space, closing paren merged.

wei: looks like merge-table pruning. did you diff merge tables? we had a generator tweak to prune rare subwords for q4-compact.

haruto: also saw one AR case where parens order flips in raw token sequence (pre-detok shows RPAREN before LPAREN). that's a sign tokenizer assigned different ids/order.

ops-bot: nightly-run: run_id=2026-04-12_03, samples=9k, flagged=94, tags=["ja-srt-merge","zh-ruby","ar-bracket-bidi"]

rui: short plan: 1) run float model with q4 tokenizer to isolate tokenizer vs model. 2) bisect generator commits for merge-table. 3) add unit tests for vertical/srt, ruby, and bidi brackets.

hana: ran step 1: float+q4-tokenizer reproduces issues. enabling token protection guard in tokenizer preserves punctuation and fixes ordering for AR sample.

wei: bisection narrowed to "prune-joiners-2026-04-01" change. I'll open a hotfix to enable protect-punct by default in generator and regen tables.

haruto: after hotfix, quick regen on subset shows flagged down 94 -> 4 (all non-blocking). will schedule full regen before flipping canary.

hana: thanks all. i'll attach failing samples to GH issue and add the new smoke checks to quant-onboard checklist.
